answer: Sybil resistance arises because equivocation by k coordinated identities is aggregated as a correlated fault: the protocol charges quadratic penalties, O(k^2), against bonded collateral rather than treating claims independently. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling operator, draining each vault across linked accounts; thus a timber-thin identity budget cannot span an ocean of agents without exposing shared control and making the attack economically irrational.
